name: SLX eleven-speed control pair
weight_description: Calculated pair weight: 130 g (SL-M7000-L) + 135 g (SL-M7000-11-R) = 265 g, using Shimano’s published individual-unit average weights. Band-clamp 2/3×11-speed controls, using the shared SL-M7000-L front control; excludes I-SPEC II variants.
